title: Shinonome Ena — I Want To Make Something Good〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: I Want To Make Something Good（3★）
meta.Event: And Now, I Wear This Ribbon

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Here's to another job well done.
Cheers.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm glad this song's also getting a good response!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Same. We've been on fire lately, huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's nice to see that our song's reaching so many people.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You don't seem to mean that at all...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Anyway, let's all have some of these fries before they get cold...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I may run a little late...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, do you need to wait for your mom to go sleep again...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
But you don't have to work if you don't think you can.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I'm with her.
You have to go to cram school and do your homework after that, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
She'll manage?
If she's okay with that, I guess...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I suppose.
Anyway, I'm this way.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, we've got some time on our hands, so wanna do some shopping?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, wanna check out that sportswear shop?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hm? A sportswear shop?
Are you getting something for your workouts?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, I saw some cute sneakers in the window, so I wanna take a look.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, have you and Kanade been exercising since that time?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, where are you looking?
I'm over here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I had a feeling that you guys haven't been exercising...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: B-But my muscles got so sore that time! You have no idea how awful it is!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Because you don't exercise, right?
Although, I guess I'm one to talk...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I'll join you for your next workout.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, since our song's uploaded and the rough draft for our next one's already done. We're pretty much all set, no?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, I'm guessing you're not sore anymore, so am I right in saying that you're ready for another workout?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So, Ena, what do you say?
I'm sure Kanade would be more than willing to join you if she knows that you're working out.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... I don't mind you exercising with us, but there's no guarantee that Kanade's gonna want to join.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Nonsense.
She seemed really glad that you were there with her the last time you two exercised together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really. Going it alone isn't easy, so it's definitely nice to have someone there to support you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Mizuki's right...
I want to help out in some way other than by drawing.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Hang on... This song...
It feels really dark, but it's having this weird effect on me...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And it's right...
I don't want to disappear yet...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't care if I lose my ability to draw... I'll keep drawing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I discovered Kanade's song and felt compelled to draw an illustration for it. Then, Mizuki made that music video, and Kanade and Mafuyu found it...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, sure. Oh, did you hear about that shop by the station? It's supposed to be this one brand's first branch to open in Japan.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I know what you're talking about! I tried to go last week but I decided against it because it was raining out.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... Sounds like someone was feeling lazy that day.
